conflicts.issue: Olfactory neuroblastoma is IVb at every site. A sinonasal neuroendocrine carcinoma (8246, 8041, 8013) is XIf10; the ICCR requires a keratin to call neuroendocrine carcinoma and names olfactory neuroblastoma as the tumour to exclude, so a mislabelled case changes group.
Laryngeal paraganglioma is IVb at every site; the laryngeal dataset counts it among neuroendocrine neoplasms.

ICCC-2017 places teratocarcinosarcoma (9081) at the nose and sinuses in Xb2, although its germ cell markers are negative and it shares SMARCA4 loss with SWI/SNF complex-deficient carcinoma (8044, XIf10). Gland-forming SMARCB1-deficient carcinoma expresses SALL4, AFP and CDX2 and can be mistaken for yolk sac tumour (9071, Xb4).

Rhabdomyosarcoma (IXa), extraosseous Ewing sarcoma (IXd2), biphenotypic sinonasal sarcoma (IXd11) and chondrosarcoma of the larynx, trachea, nose and sinuses (IXd9) are Group IX. Adamantinoma-like Ewing sarcoma mimics non-keratinising squamous cell carcinoma; a spindle cell malignancy of the larynx is spindle cell squamous carcinoma (XIf10) unless the report names a sarcoma.
Chordoma (VIIId2), malignant odontogenic tumours including metastasising ameloblastoma (VIIId3) and Ewing sarcoma of bone (VIIIc2) are Group VIII; each is recaptured to its bone site.
Adamantinomatous craniopharyngioma (IIIe2) and meningioma (IIIe5) are Group III at every site and at behaviours 0 and 1, so the sinonasal tree refers them rather than excluding them.
Lymphoma, including nasal NK/T-cell lymphoma (IIb3) and plasmablastic lymphoma, and Langerhans cell histiocytosis (IId) are Group II. Rule D makes a Waldeyer ring (C14.2) lymphoma nodal.
Myeloid sarcoma is Ib and keeps its head and neck site (Rule E).
ICCC-2017 places 8000-8005 at these sites in XIIb, so a registration without tissue (basis 1 or 2) or a cytology report of malignant cells only is computed to Group XII, not XIf10.
A melanotic neuroectodermal tumour called malignant (9363/3, XIIa6) and myoepithelial carcinoma, malignant mixed tumour and carcinosarcoma of a minor salivary gland (XIIa4) are Group XII.
Within Group XI: a carcinoma of the lip vermilion or mucosa is C00 (XIf10); of the skin of the lip C44.0 (XIe). Rule A at site capture decides.

Within Group XI: a nasopharyngeal carcinoma extending into the nasal cavity is coded at the nasopharynx (XIc); sinonasal lymphoepithelial carcinoma is identical to nasopharyngeal carcinoma and is separated only by location. A tumour over the nasopharynx and oropharynx with no stated origin is C14.8 (XIf10).

Within Group XI: base of tongue, lingual tonsil, soft palate and uvula sit in ICD-O C01-C05 but the WHO oral chapter covers the oral cavity and mobile tongue only. The XIc part's oropharynx screens (op_squamous_hpv) cover C09-C10; the controller decides whether these four sites route there.

Within Group XI: a minor salivary gland carcinoma is coded at the site of the gland (XIf10), not at the major glands (XIf1). The salivary part's sg_site answer re-sites it to this tree; hn_salivary hands the long tail back to sg_carcinoma_picker.
